title: Retire closed-issue Production runtime parity bridge

phases.objective: Remove the permanently unreachable Production parity bridge bound to closed historical Issue #4953 and retain Hostinger Production Runtime Readback R7 as the sole supported exact-SHA, public-GET-only runtime parity entrypoint.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository workflow registrar and governance runner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A bounded pull request removes the closed-Issue bridge and adds an exact retirement regression.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: No live workflow is bound to Issue #4953 or accepts RUN_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_PARITY, while canonical R7 remains present, read-only, exact-SHA-bound, public-GET-only, and secret-free.
steps: Remove the Production Runtime Parity Comment Bridge workflow bound to closed Issue #4953.
Remove the bridge-specific E2E contract and regression test.
Scan all live workflow files for the retired command, workflow name, and Issue #4953 binding.
Require the canonical R7 workflow, contract, and regression to remain present.
Verify R7 accepts only authorized pull-request comments with an exact Production SHA.
Verify R7 uses fixed public HTTPS GET endpoints and declares every mutation/effect flag false.
assertions: The three historical bridge paths remain absent.
No live workflow contains RUN_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_PARITY or production-runtime-parity-comment-bridge.
No live workflow is bound to github.event.issue.number == 4953.
Hostinger Production Runtime Readback R7 remains the sole supported runtime-parity entrypoint.
R7 retains contents: read and no repository, provider, credential, build, deployment, restart, SQL, migration, database, or external-send mutation authority.

No runtime probe, Hostinger action, deployment, restart, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force push, credential access, or external send occurs during retirement validation.

phases.objective: Confirm repository workflow registration exposes R7 and no closed-Issue bridge after merge.
Reject future reintroduction of the retired command, workflow identity, or historical Issue #4953 control binding.
Retirement validation performs no runtime probe or provider canary.
Prove protected main contains one authoritative runtime-parity entrypoint and no dead historical control binding.
